newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - GTE announces Cisco alliance.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - GTE announces Cisco alliance.

text.p: GTE said Tuesday it entered a strategic alliance with Cisco Systems to develop enhanced data/internet services. GTE said purchases from Cisco could reach over $1 billion.
A full text of the company's press release follows.

SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 6, 1997--GTE and Cisco Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) today announced a relationship that will build an end-to-end service network which will enable GTE to rapidly deploy value-added services and drive next-generation Internet Protocol (IP) offerings.
This relationship will quickly create differentiated services for GTE customers while enabling GTE to reduce time to market, lower cost of ownership and simplify network management.

"GTE is making an end-to-end commitment to Cisco in key areas," said Charles R. Lee, GTE chairman and chief executive officer. "This commitment creates an opportunity to deploy an integrated service fabric that facilitates access to compelling content, solutions and services."

To support these services GTE will build a national network based on Cisco's Wide Area Network (WAN) ATM switches, high-end routers, and dial access platforms. GTE purchases could reach over $1 billion of Cisco products for resale as bundled solutions and to support this new national infrastructure over the next five years.

"This combination will create a fundamentally new offering in the marketplace," said John Chambers, president and chief executive officer at Cisco. "GTE will have leadership capabilities to provide integrated end-to-end services across all layers of the network such as multimedia, quality, and security. The relationship will accelerate the deployment of these and other services through the alignment of our core competencies."

In addition to large-scale network deployment, this relationship will include product collaboration, systems enhancement and service creation projects. Through these projects, GTE will have the capability to redefine product and service creation cycles and leverage Cisco's strengths in networking technologies for the Internet.

Cisco will also offer GTE an industry-leading portfolio of service and networked support programs that will include installation and implementation services to quickly install and configure systems, maintenance services to ensure maximum system uptime and reliability, and access to the latest Cisco IOS(TM) software enhancements through Cisco's Web site. About GTE

With revenues of more than $21 billion in 1996, GTE is one of the largest publicly held telecommunications companies in the world. In the United States, GTE offers local and wireless service in 29 states and long-distance service in all 50 states. GTE was the first among its peers to offer "one-stop shopping" for local, long-distance and Internet access services.

Outside the United States, where GTE has operated for more than 40 years, the company serves over 6.5 million customers. GTE is also a leader in government and defense communications systems and equipment, directories and telecommunications-based information services, and aircraft-passenger telecommunications.
